Question B-006-010-007.

Why the correct answer is right: Downward-sloping quarter-wave radials are the matching arrangement expected for an elevated quarter-wave vertical.

Per-choice notes:
- sourceIndex 0: "Downward sloping quarter-wave radials": Correct. Downward-sloping quarter-wave radials are the matching arrangement expected for an elevated quarter-wave vertical.
- sourceIndex 1: "Horizontal quarter-wave radials": That item can be part of an RF return or grounding system, but it is not the feedline between radio and antenna.
- sourceIndex 2: "Horizontal half-wave radials": That item can be part of an RF return or grounding system, but it is not the feedline between radio and antenna.
- sourceIndex 3: "Upward sloping half-wave radials": That item can be part of an RF return or grounding system, but it is not the feedline between radio and antenna.
